summary: Verified the new GCSHARP Study Center features end-to-end (backend + frontend). Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 10 new tests covering /api/papers filters/list/detail/pdf-proxy/qa/video/ask and /api/drafts toggle/list/saved-flag — all 10 pass. Playwright e2e against the preview URL verified: GCSHARP brand rename (login, sidebar, title, no GCSMART left), 4 Study Center tabs, 12 seeded paper cards, filter narrowing (paper=1 -> 5 cards) and clear-filters reset, save-to-Drafts toggle round-trip in the grid AND the Drafts tab, opening Paper 1 (pap_71501c2ba7f8) -> PDF renders (Page 1/9), 'Generate Step-by-Step Q&A' produces worked solutions (Q1..Q4 with steps + Answer), opening Paper 2 (pap_68b3f5254f5e) -> 'Generate Video Solution' renders VideoSolutionPlayer with animated whiteboard, vid-play/vid-next controls, and TTS audio (Narrating...), highlight text in PDF -> floating 'Ask GC AI' popup appears -> click renders 'GC AI Answer' panel with real LLM response, reader-save-draft toggles. AI is real (openai gpt-5.4 + tts-1), cached IDs kept waits short.

issues: react-pdf logs repeated console warning: 'File prop passed to <Document /> changed, but it's equal to previous one. Consider memoizing the value passed to file prop.' The `file` prop object is rebuilt on every render — wrap in useMemo({ url, withCredentials:true }) keyed on paperId to eliminate needless re-fetch cycles.
Canvas2D warning: 'Multiple readback operations using getImageData are faster with the willReadFrequently attribute set to true.' Comes from react-pdf canvas renderer; low priority.
Legacy Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings still emitted from Dashboard mount when navigating (carried over from iteration_1).

action_items: (Optional, perf) Memoize the `file` prop passed to react-pdf <Document/> in PaperReader.jsx so it isn't a new object each render.
(Optional) Add willReadFrequently or ignore the canvas warning (comes from react-pdf internals).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/papers/{id}/qa and /video correctly cache in paper_qa_cache / paper_video_cache but have NO invalidation path — if the seeded pdf_url changes the cached content will be stale forever. Consider a paper.updated_at watermark or admin cache-clear endpoint.

POST /api/papers/{id}/video stores base64 audio for every scene inside MongoDB (approx 300KB * 6 scenes ≈ 1.8MB per doc). Approaching Mongo's 16MB per-doc limit if scenes grow; consider offloading audio to GridFS or object storage.
server.py is now 833 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Split into routers/papers.py, routers/drafts.py, routers/ai.py.

PaperReader: `file` prop object literal `{ url, withCredentials:true }` is recreated every render; combined with `onLoadSuccess` this triggers repeated PDF loads (see console warnings). Wrap in useMemo.
Video/QA endpoints bypass a per-user rate limit; a student can hammer POST /api/papers/{id}/qa uncached forever.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed idempotently seeded 12 GCE past papers. Toggled draft for pap_e8ea989ede35 (created + removed). No leftover TEST_ artifacts from this iteration.
